text:
Samir Patel: hitting a pretty nasty repro locally — async client + streaming -> auth refresh + retry = duplicate resource create.
Samir Patel: minimal flow: start streaming upload, token refresh happens mid-stream, client retries the request, server processes create again.
Samir Patel: short log:
```
INFO UploadStream: started
WARNING auth: token expired -> refresh triggered
DEBUG http.retries: attempt=2 replaying request
INFO Server: created object id=abcd1234
INFO Server: created object id=abcd1234  # duplicate
```
Priya Rao: whoa. does the SDK attach an idempotency key?
Samir Patel: we were setting X-Idempotency-Key for the initial request, but async retry path seems to regenerate one instead of reusing it when replaying streaming body.
Priya Rao: can you paste the request code?
Samir Patel:
```
async with RedwoodAsyncClient(token=tok) as c:
    headers = {"X-Idempotency-Key": uuid4().hex}
    async with c.stream_post("/uploads", headers=headers, data=stream_gen()) as r:
        async for chunk in r.aiter_bytes():
            ...
```
Samir Patel: if refresh triggers, the retry branch calls _prepare_request() which ends up doing uuid4() again in our app helper -> new key.
Liam Turner: confirmed similar earlier, but I thought retries should reuse original headers for replay. might be a bug in how we serialize and stash the prepared_request for async streaming.
Maya Chen: can you repro with the sync client too? that helps narrow runtime vs codepath.
Samir Patel: sync client shows same behavior but less common because refresh race timing differs. reproducible with artificial token expiry.
Priya Rao: filing as two asks: 1) fix so prepared request keeps original idempotency header across retries, 2) document best-practice for streaming uploads (e.g., use pre-signed URL + resume?).
Maya Chen: workaround for now — generate idempotency key outside and pass constant, not call helper inline. also set small retry window while streaming.
devx-bot: created issue #3221: "async client: idempotency key regen on retry causes duplicate creates when auth refresh occurs during streaming" and linked PR template.
Liam Turner: for an actual fix we should: stash original headers on prepare, copy headers into retry request without calling app-level header factories, and ensure body clones or avoid body-consuming reserializations for streams.
Priya Rao: also add a unit test simulating mid-stream auth refresh and ensure only one server create.
Samir Patel: will attach a short repro script and logs to #3221. thanks all :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: +1 on backport to last minor release, this is a customer-facing dup-create risk.
Liam Turner: assigning to eng-ml on the issue for triage if it touches async transport layer.
Priya Rao: adding note: typing for RedwoodAsyncClient.request should indicate whether headers are 'frozen' for retries — helps DX for fetchers.
Samir Patel: yep, and sample app in docs showing safe streaming pattern would avoid a lot of confusion.
Maya Chen: cool. if you need someone to review the test let me know.
